{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the unique values in the 'status' column to verify 'completed' is valid
print("Unique values in 'status':", sales['status'].unique())

# Check the 'revenue' column for non-numeric values
print("Unique values in 'revenue':", sales['revenue'].unique())

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion errors
print("Number of rows with non-numeric revenue:", sales['revenue_numeric'].isna().sum())

# Display the first few rows of the new column
sales[['revenue', 'revenue_numeric']].head()"}
